name: dot-stepper
title: Dot Stepper
description: A minimal dot-based stepper/pagination component with small and xsmall sizes. Supports asChild for Radix integration. Uses namespace exports: DotStepper.Root, DotStepper.Item.

docs.lead: A minimal dot-based stepper component with two sizes and active state highlighting for step navigation.
docs.usage:
import * as DotStepper from "@/components/ui/dot-stepper"

<DotStepper.Root size="small">
  <DotStepper.Item active onClick={() => {}} />
  <DotStepper.Item onClick={() => {}} />
</DotStepper.Root>

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Dot stepper in small and xsmall sizes with interactive step selection.
examples.code:
<DotStepper.Root size="small">
  <DotStepper.Item active={activeStep === 0} onClick={() => setActiveStep(0)} />
  <DotStepper.Item active={activeStep === 1} onClick={() => setActiveStep(1)} />
</DotStepper.Root>

examples.title: With Radix Tabs
examples.description: Dot stepper composed with Radix UI Tabs using the asChild pattern for accessible tab navigation.
examples.code:
<TabsPrimitives.Root value={activeStep} onValueChange={setActiveStep}>
  <DotStepper.Root asChild>
    <TabsPrimitives.List>
      <DotStepper.Item active={activeStep === step.id} asChild>
        <TabsPrimitives.Trigger value={step.id} />
      </DotStepper.Item>
    </TabsPrimitives.List>
  </DotStepper.Root>
</TabsPrimitives.Root>

api.name: DotStepper.Root
api.description: The container for dot stepper items. Propagates size to children via recursiveCloneChildren.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: DotStepper.Item
api.description: An individual dot step. Renders as a button by default.

props.name: active
props.description: Whether this step is currently active

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element using Radix Slot
